title: playwright_missing · browser_missing — web setup is needed
symptom: web open ends with playwright_missing (no Playwright) or browser_missing (Chromium is not installed)
cause: Web control uses Playwright and a browser in a dedicated virtual environment (under ~/.projectops). It is not set up yet, or the package exists but the browser files are missing
fix: Ask the user before installing (about 100 MB): launch_cli.py web setup
On an internal network, use an installed Chrome · Edge: prefix web open with LAUNCH_CHROMIUM_PATH=<browser executable path>
If web setup fails with pip_failed, install playwright pillow from the internal PyPI mirror first (ask the user first)
